verdicts.reason: A keeps the original reading order: logo, eyebrow, headline, body. The headline is readable and the CTA is clear. Flaws: the body copy is jammed right under the headline. The CTA sits isolated on the right with a stray divider above it. The top-right is dead space, and the logo bar is cropped at the left edge. B has a better-sized CTA but is cramped and jumbled. The oversized headline runs close to the top edge and the body is jammed under it. The body text nearly touches the CTA. The eyebrow 'LIMITED SUMMER RELEASE' is orphaned at the bottom-left, below the headline, and butts against the body text. The logo floats mid-left on a clipped white bar, and a stray rule sits under it. The hierarchy and grouping are broken.
